chain: multi-chain (BNB primary, ETH, ARB, SOL + Aster Chain PoSA)
architecture: Multi-chain perp DEX. Born from Astherus + APX Finance merger (late 2024), rebranded Aster March 2025. Not a rollup. Launched 'Aster Chain' (PoSA L1) March 2026 but main trading still on BNB/ETH/ARB/SOL.

aster_chain_contracts.note: Aster Chain (PoSA) core contracts not disclosed. Docs state 'not open-sourced.'

upgrade_key.note: Upgrade key management not publicly disclosed. Confirmed not disclosed in official docs.

funds_location.note: Per-chain bridge contracts on BNB, ETH, ARB, SOL. Not on a single chain.

contracts_verified.note: Docs state bridge contracts 'will be publicly disclosed.' Core chain not open-sourced. No independent verification performed at time of measurement.

chain_l2beat_stage.note: Not tracked by L2Beat. Not a rollup or L2.

upgrade_delay_seconds.note: Upgrade key management not disclosed. No timelock documented.

lp_exit.note: Aster uses an LP pool model. Early exit from staking incurs penalties of 2-60%. Cross-chain LP withdrawals require 2-of-3 internal validator co-signature.

trader_exit.mechanism: Close position on-chain → cross-chain withdrawal requires 2-of-3 internal validator co-signature → USDC to user wallet

can_user_exit_unilaterally.qualifier: Cross-chain withdrawals require internal 2-of-3 validator sign-off. No forced exit or escape hatch documented.

exit_depends_on.value: 2-of-3 internal validators + Chainlink/Pyth oracles + off-chain matching engine

alternative_frontend.note: Core chain closed source. No permissionless alternative documented.
